opportunity.title: Material Management
opportunity.subAgency: Dept of the Navy (Military Sealift Command)
opportunity.description: Military Sealift Command sources sought for non-personal logistics services at MSC ashore locations worldwide: material receipt, stowage, special-material stowage, transportation, disposal, centrally managed stock, inventory audits, and warehouse equipment. Requires a SECRET facility clearance, 98% inventory accuracy, handling of hazardous material and small arms, ship decommissioning support, and 24/7 surge capability. One base year plus four option years starting 19 September 2027. No set-aside used.

sources.title: MSC - About MSC
sources.snippet:
### Our Mission

The U.S. Navy's Military Sealift Command is the premier provider of ocean transportation to the Department of Defense. The Command operates approximately 125 civilian-crewed ships that replenish U.S. Navy ships, conduct specialized missions, strategically preposition combat cargo at sea around the world and move military cargo and supplies used by deployed U.S. forces and coalition partners.

supportedClaims.text: The Military Sealift Command’s Logistics department handles inventory, storekeeping, cargo handling, receipt and stowage, matching the requirement for material receipt, stowage, hazardous material handling, and inventory audits.
The requirement calls for a SECRET clearance, and facility clearances are issued at Confidential, Secret, and Top Secret levels.
Obtaining a Secret facility clearance requires sponsorship and can be a lengthy process, posing a risk for timely award.
MSC’s mission is to provide ocean transportation and logistics support worldwide, aligning with the requirement for worldwide MSC ashore locations.
